subject: Cohort promo stacking and conversion incentive proposal
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@launchhub.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry — stacking cohort promo with conversion incentive

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — I manage partnerships at LaunchHub Accelerator. We’re finalizing benefits for our August cohort and I wanted to check whether Redwood can support two things:

1) Allow cohort promotional credits (the standard $5k stipend you offer cohort partners) to be layered on top of the starter credits you give new startups, and
2) Offer a conversion/retention incentive that gives startups a discount if they convert to a paid plan within 45 days of demoing and hitting an agreed usage threshold.

Our goal is to reduce friction for founders to try the product during the program and then keep them as paying customers. If stacking isn’t standard, would Redwood consider a limited exception for LaunchHub cohorts? If yes, what guardrails would you need (caps, time windows, invoicing rules)?

Thanks — if it helps I can share sample term language.

Best,
Emily Chen
Partnerships Lead, LaunchHub Accelerator
emily@launchhub.org
[Attachment: launchhub-cohort-outline.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@launchhub.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry — stacking cohort promo with conversion incentive

Hi Emily — great to hear from you, and congrats on the upcoming cohort. Short answer: we normally don’t allow full stacking of promotional credits + starter credits, but we do make programmatic exceptions for strategic accelerator partners with clear conversion paths.

A couple of quick questions so I can scope this with finance/legal:
- Are the $5k cohort credits applied as Redwood-sponsored credits on the company account or distributed as one-time top-ups to individual founders?
- What’s the expected conversion window (you mentioned 45 days) and do you want a dollar-off coupon or a percentage discount once they convert?
- Estimate: how many startups (approx.) would be eligible from the cohort?

Proposed approach we can explore internally: limited stacking where cohort credits can be applied, capped at $6k per company total, plus a short-term conversion discount (e.g., 25% off first 3 months if they convert within 60 days and meet an agreed usage floor). This keeps the unit economics protected while giving founders a clear path. I’ll run this past Ben and Lauren for approval — I’ll loop them in now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@redwoodinference.com, legal@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Inquiry — stacking cohort promo with conversion incentive

Marissa / Lauren — forwarding Emily from LaunchHub. Our default policy: promo credits are not stackable with onboarding/starter credits to avoid dilution. That said, for partner cohorts we can do a controlled exception if we set caps and conversion guardrails.

Quick suggested guardrails for approval:
- Stacking allowed up to a combined cap of $6000 per company (includes any starter credit + cohort stipend).
- Conversion incentive: 25% off subscription price for first 3 billing cycles or $X off invoice (finance prefers percent), valid if the company converts within 60 days and consumes at least $500 of paid usage during trial.
- Credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- Offer limited to this one cohort pilot; requires a signed MOU and is non-transferable.

Attached: proposal-draft.pdf (draft term sheet) and pricing-schedule.csv (impact model). Finance: please confirm we can grandfather this under a special promo code rather than a custom invoice flow. Legal: any red flags?

—Ben
[Attachment: proposal-draft.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: pricing-schedule.csv (CSV)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Inquiry — stacking cohort promo with conversion incentive

Thanks for drafting, Ben. I reviewed the proposed guardrails and am comfortable approving a limited exception for LaunchHub’s August cohort with these clarifications:

1) Cap: Combined credits capped at $6k per company (explicitly includes any previously granted starter credits).
2) Conversion incentive: 25% off the first 3 invoices after conversion, valid if conversion occurs within 60 days of initial activation and cumulative paid usage >= $500 during the trial window.
3) Credits expire 90 days; conversion discount window is 60 days.
4) Bookkeeping: apply cohort credit via promo code assigned to LaunchHub; finance to track redemptions against promo budget. No manual invoice credits unless escalated.
5) Limit: pilot applies to the August 2027 cohort only; review impact after 90 days and decide whether to formalize.

Ben — finance can you confirm promo code creation flow and how we'll record revenue impact? Legal — please confirm the MOU addendum language is fine; we want the clause that discounts are not stackable with future enterprise discounts.

If there are no objections I’ll sign off and Marissa can send final terms to Emily.

—Lauren
VP, Partnerships Operations
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@launchhub.org>, LaunchHub Accelerator <contracts@launchhub.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Final terms — LaunchHub August cohort promotional stack + conversion incentive

Hi Emily — thanks for the patience. Following internal review we can offer a limited pilot exception for your August cohort with the following terms:

- Stacking: cohort promotional stipend may be stacked with starter credits up to a combined cap of $6,000 per company (this cap includes any starter credits previously issued).
- Conversion incentive: 25% off the first 3 invoices after conversion if the company converts within 60 days of activation and records at least $500 of paid usage during the trial window.
- Expiry: credits must be redeemed within 90 days of issuance.
- Scope: pilot applies only to the August 2027 LaunchHub cohort and is non-transferable.
- Ops: we will issue a promo code for LaunchHub; finance will track redemptions. No manual invoice credits except by exception.

Next steps:
1) If these terms look good, sign the attached MOU addendum and return via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/launchhub-cohort-term-sheet
2) Tell us the expected count of startups (approx.) so we can precreate the promo code and budget-check.
3) We’ll activate the promo code once the signed MOU is back.

Attached: proposal-draft.pdf (finalized MOU addendum).

Thanks — excited to partner on this cohort.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: proposal-draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Emily Chen <emily@launchhub.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final terms — LaunchHub August cohort promotional stack + conversion incentive

Marissa — this looks great, thank you. LaunchHub accepts the pilot terms. We expect ~18 startups in the track that will be eligible. I’ve routed the MOU addendum to our contracts team and they will return a signed DocuSign within 48 hours.

A couple of small asks: could you shorten the redemption window to 75 days instead of 90? We prefer founders have urgency but still time to run the program. Also, can the promo code be single-use per startup (we’ll provide unique company registrations)?

If those are fine with you, we’ll sign. Appreciate the flexibility.

—Emily
Partnerships Lead, LaunchHub Accelerator
emily@launchhub.org
